title: America's richest men go into the woods and play with fire 🦉🔥
caption:
Bohemian Grove is real. So is the owl. 🦉
Count the hidden owls 👀 and comment your number.
Send this to the friend who'd get invited 😏
first_comment: How many owls did you spot? 🦉👇
